scope: One v3 four-engine private whole-reduction cohort; explicit original qualification CASE-first preparation, all exact and numerical gates unchanged; no production adoption or combined-cohort ratios.
project_policy: No concurrent project builds, reference/numerical kernels, tests, installations, benchmarks or long analysis. Source writing and small read-only review only. All workers acknowledged holds; only native_stack_batch receives a separate start grant.
external_host_policy: Shared host uncontrolled; unrelated processes unchanged. Retain failed, short, noisy, unsupported and unrun cases; no CI-dependent repeats or exclusions.
ratio_policy: Every displayed ratio has TIRust numerator: baselineTIRust/IREGI, candidateTIRust/IREGI, baselineTIRust/COLLIER, candidateTIRust/COLLIER, candidateTIRust/baselineTIRust. No cross-session synthesis.
holds_acknowledged: python_interface: full native typecheck complete; no further Cargo/build/test/install during hold
highpoint_coverage: generic source-only; all runtime/builds idle
collier_extended_resume: saved-data tests finished, reference/CLI/heavy audits held
marimo_notebooks: strict lint/helper tests finished; actual-wheel execution held
numeric_batch_audit: statistics/source reviews finished; compute idle
native_stack_batch: preflight and independent audit passed; no active compute
immutability: Do not rewrite this manifest. Append events/completion separately and bind this exact hash.
